input.quote: "CORIO MARKET SEGMENT" means those customers with annual sales revenues of less than $1,000,000,000.
input.rationale: There is no covenant restricting the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build; the only scope limits are licence-scope ones (the Corio Market Segment and the North America Territory), and they come with the right to retain Customers that grow past the threshold and an expansion mechanism under Section 2.10 in which consent cannot be unreasonably withheld. Worth noting as commercial scope, not a restrictive covenant.

input.quote: Under no circumstances shall Commerce One contact Corio Customers regarding a non-ASP license sale, unless requested to do so by Corio.
input.rationale: No exclusivity, sole-supplier or requirements obligation binds us; the licences are expressly nonexclusive and we remain free to source competing software. The only channel restraint runs against Commerce One (no direct approaches to our Customers, referrals back to us), which benefits us and we leave intact.
